attacks.name: Mischiefs and Magicks
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!critical| |!wild| |*Bamboozle|: After the attack is resolved, this character may Advance the target character |!range_small|. Then the target character gains the |§root§Root| special condition.

attacks.name: Clever Ploy
steps: After each attack is resolved, if that attack dealt |!damage|, this character Advances the target character |!range_small|.
Allied characters in range of this attack do not suffer damage from it.

superPowers.name: I Come Bearing Gifts (Affiliation: Asgard)
superPowers.body: While another allied character is attacking, defending, or dodging, during the |*Modify Dice| step, it may spend 1 |!power|. If it does, it may reroll one of its dice and this character gains 1 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Go Forth!
superPowers.body: Choose another allied character within |!range| 4. Place the chosen character within |!range| 2 of its current location. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Oh My, What A Pity
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character or an allied character within |!range| 3, or after an attack made by this character is resolved, it may use this superpower. If the enemy character's roll contains any |!failure| results, that character suffers 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Asgardian
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.

superPowers.name: This isn‘t Mischief, This is Mayhem
superPowers.body: When attacking or defending, this character adds |!failure| results in the enemy character's roll to its total successes.
